Name: Dynamic Dialogues framework
Author: mistyspring
Description:
[size=3][u][b]This mod is a framework / tool for modders[/b][/u]

"Dynamic dialogues" makes dialogues more customizable via CP.
Some dialogue features are only avaiable to SMAPI mods- this mod lets you use them easily.
[b]
Features:[/b]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Location specific dialogue[/size]
[*][size=3]Time specific dialogue[/size]
[*][size=3](+notifs)[/size]
[*][size=3]Custom greetings when passing by a NPC.[/size]
[*][size=3]Ask NPC questions (when there's nothing else to talk about).[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[b]Dialogue features:[/b]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Shake[/size]
[*][size=3]Emote[/size]
[*][size=3]Jump[/size]
[*][size=3]Face a new direction[/size]
[*][size=3]Say the dialogue as a bubble[/size]
[*]Force/ Sa[size=3]y dialogue when you're not in the location[/size]
[/list][size=3]
All of this fully configurable. [/size]
[size=3]
Example of a patch:[/size]
[code]﻿{
      "Action": "EditData",
      "Target": "mistyspring.dynamicdialogues/Dialogues/Lewis",
      "Entries": {
        "exampleEdit": {
          "Time": "630",
          "Dialogue": "@?! It's 6:30!",
          "IsBubble": "true",
          "ClearOnMove": "true",
          "Jump": "true",
          "Shake": 1000
        }
      }
    }
[/code]
[size=3][url=https://github.com/misty-spring/StardewMods/tree/main/DynamicDialogues]Documentation and source code[/url] are avaiable in github.[/size]
